title: petrosedum × hommelsii
intro: Petrosedum × hommelsii, commonly known as Living Rock or Ice Plant, is a hybrid succulent plant in the family Crassulaceae. This plant is known for its small, white or pink flowers and its ability to store water in its leaves, making it a popular choice for low-maintenance gardens and indoor spaces. The health benefits of Petrosedum × hommelsii include its potential to help lower blood pressure and improve circulation, while its therapeutic actions are said to include reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full potential.
